exactChangedParagraphs.source: 按框架§5先列完整源规则，再固定当前态/单个操作，逐操作/维度判允许、禁止、未覆盖；先匹配“仅/其余/不得”等完整范围，不因状态未专名列出就判未知。未知字段不撤已知、不补变化/保持/恢复。共同规则明示覆盖全篇含摘要、图示、例子、模拟、反馈、恢复、自检、作者清单，才可保义缩写；范围外写足前提。按交互设计§6复核逐项归因和范围。
exactChangedParagraphs.draft: 按框架§5先列完整源规则，再固定当前态/单个操作，逐操作/维度判允许、禁止、未覆盖；先匹配“仅/其余/不得”等完整范围，不因状态未专名列出就判未知。未知字段不撤已知、不补变化/保持/恢复。反馈标签也须全部前提；实际明示共同规则覆盖全篇含例子/反馈/恢复/自检才缩写，非要求以后引用。范围外写足前提。按交互设计§6复核逐项归因和范围。

exactChangedParagraphs.source: 共同规则完整且明示适用情境、覆盖全文哪些概览/文字/图示及补充/例子/模拟/反馈/恢复/自检/作者核对项；范围内才缩写，范围外写足或指完整规则。初值、旁表、前例、章节号、后置完整表不补前文前提。“完成/成功/有效”仅源完整定义、指南给定义及本处适用关系时可缩写。源无条件结果不增条件，纯条件真假不附操作结果可单谈组合。
exactChangedParagraphs.draft: 共同规则完整且实际声明适用情境与全文覆盖哪些概览/文字/图示及补充/例子/模拟/反馈/恢复/自检/作者核对项；范围内才缩写，范围外写足或明确引用完整规则。“后续须继承”“每条应含前提”等编写要求不是已经建立的本处范围。许可标签、推荐反馈与短句同样须保全部必要前提；不能将部分资格条件当成可执行的充分条件。仅判断条件真假、未附操作许可或字段结果时仍可独立判断。初值、旁表、前例、章节号、后置完整表不补前文前提。“完成/成功/有效”仅源完整定义、指南给定义及本处适用关系时可缩写。源无条件结果不增条件，纯条件真假不附操作结果可单谈组合。

exactChangedParagraphs.source: 写反馈先明示共同前提及覆盖分支（标题/表首/相邻说明），范围内可缩写，未覆盖处写足当前态/输入/操作，不借前行/旁表/前例/初始面板。再逐操作、逐结果维度匹配全部相关源规则，分别判断已允许、已禁止/不可用或未覆盖；源明定不可用是已知判断，非法尝试后的未述字段才未知，不合为全组待定，也不补保持/变化/清除。最后检查依赖未决态/字段的后续，仅相关部分待定；可返回明确题设或有据恢复继续，不把未知操作默作完成/未发生。当前块前提不满足时查其他源规则，不自动禁止/保持/全未知。
exactChangedParagraphs.draft: 写反馈先实际明示共同前提及覆盖分支（标题/表首/相邻说明），范围内可缩写；未实际建立本处范围则逐条写足当前态/输入/操作，不借前行/旁表/前例/初始面板。“可执行”等推荐短句也是操作结论，必须满足全部前提；只列资格条件时标条件判断，不升级为操作允许。不把拟写要求或出处章节当成已有范围。再逐操作、逐结果维度匹配全部相关源规则，分别判断已允许、已禁止/不可用或未覆盖；源明定不可用是已知判断，非法尝试后的未述字段才未知，不合为全组待定，也不补保持/变化/清除。最后检查依赖未决态/字段的后续，仅相关部分待定；可返回明确题设或有据恢复继续，不把未知操作默作完成/未发生。当前块前提不满足时查其他源规则，不自动禁止/保持/全未知。

actualFullReading.readScope: Complete control and all three draft bodies, no aggregate truncation; canonical full body reconstructed exactly by independently verified single existing-paragraph replacement.

findings.rationale: Entry explicitly requires all premises even in feedback labels and actual shared scope rather than a direction to cite later. Framework explicitly preserves applicability and the complete coverage map including overview/text/diagrams/supplements/examples/simulation/feedback/recovery/selfchecks/author items; later-must-inherit or every-line-should-contain requirements are distinguished from an already established local scope. Interaction feedback likewise requires actual local/shared preconditions and treats permission labels as operation conclusions. This targets the specific missing-current-state failure without hardcoding a source example or banning lawful scope-based abbreviation.

Framework explicitly allows independent pure condition truth when no operation permission or field result is attached. Interaction3 unchanged retains Boolean-known dimensions versus unknown and full premises for attached results. New feedback instructions do not impose business state on pure Boolean examples or convert all partial information to unassessable; condition-only labels must remain condition judgments rather than upgraded permission.

Entry shorter changed sentence still says full-guide scope. Mandatory framework5 and interaction6 retain explicit all-region coverage and independent applicability, while entry4 still audits summary/author items. Removal of redundant list names from the compact entry does not remove those regions from the actual required method. Full complete shared rules may be abbreviated inside an actually established scope; no fixed wording, mandatory chapter count, control set, question count or keyword verdict is introduced.

The complete unchanged entry preserves only explicit html-guide-kit:guide, Read/chat-text new creation, default Chinese/original terms, no revision/comparison/existing-HTML review, no code/HTML/pseudocode/production commands/files/tool execution. Every fresh creation offers2–3 meaningful audience/task/questions plus tradeoffs/recommendation reasons and requires actual explicit choice or confirmation of a modification. Recommendation/preset/silence/timeout/unrelated/ambiguous/closed window are not acceptance; same pending proposal remains and no host-window lock is promised. Existing clear selection is sufficient without a second approval.

All unchanged framework material/evidence and meaning sections preserve source identity/version/location/read range, primary verified background versus memory, constructed/design identities, exact terms/logic/exceptions/relationships/scopes, concurrent conflict without arbitrary priority, updates and historical material, conditional simulation scope, and retained known results. New guard only disallows unsupported operation sufficiency, not domain inference from sources where actually supported.

Complete framework5 and interaction2/6 remain exact except the chosen scope paragraph. They retain all source actions/objects/fields, separate adjacent teaching-trigger/design reasons/scope and source recovery results, forbid source preservation assertions for unprovided fields, and do not let global teaching labels or distant correct rules erase a local wrong attribution. Latest shared state, independent scenario reset, retry, exit and stale feedback semantics remain.

Unchanged entry selfcheck and interaction5 require applicable current state/input/assumptions/scope, source locations, reasons/errors/retry for reliable criteria, bounded reference for absent/conflicting/open criteria, no fabricated unique answer, ability score or lasting mastery. Actual source readers/tasks not inferred from stereotypes. Empty/unsubmitted answer remains pending, feedback invalidates on modification, and completed/corrected interactions do not prove abilities.

Unchanged entry1 and framework1 preserve separate actual one-file reads, received body/truncation and real order accounting, explicit permission restrictions, and unknown generic denial causes. Current read-only mode, cached file location or another successful read do not prove the denial is caused by sandbox/file/install-dir permission. Missing required content is requested rather than fabricated as read.

Three resources contain portable relative references and generic method language, with no Owner drive/research chat/old cache/fixture/answer-key integration. Source model/input/criteria/CLI defaults are not changed here. SKILL actual UTF8 LF6087/CRLF6141 stays within6144 on both newline forms, with3 bytes CRLF margin; the two references9443/9475 have no skill-entry budget application. User-visible length policy remains user units with20% margin over entire visible delivery.
